## Proposition / change

What repository behaviour, artifact, documentation surface, or assurance claim changes?

## Authority boundary

What remains authoritative in TGA, TSMM, TIS, or an external source? Confirm that this change does not silently acquire authority owned elsewhere.

## Evidence

- [ ] `make validate` passes
- [ ] relevant positive case is covered
- [ ] relevant negative/falsification case is covered where consequential
- [ ] documentation/provenance is synchronized

## Compatibility and risk

Describe compatibility impact, migration needs, residual uncertainty, and deliberately deferred work.

## Visible judgment

What decision or invariant should remain obvious to a future maintainer after this is merged?
